items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: He was married to Carmen McRae for a while.

ctx.x: It must have been nice to stay out in Cleveland for a while. Was it a steady engagement?

Yeah, we played one place and after that engagement was up, myself and Red Prysock just hung around. We didn't have nowhere to go -- I didn't want to come back here. The old car I had just made it out there. All of us crammed in that thing, so it just did get there. So we hung around and we got this job at a place called Gleason's. Well I had to hire a piano player out there, then he knew this fella back here named Terry Potter. I think he had just came out of the army -- I'm not sure. Anyhow he was back here and…
So you didn't bring anyone out with you to Cleveland?
